decision: Extend the canonical test inventory only with four SHA-256 representation and streaming-reader contract tests for the sha2 0.11 API migration.
reason: The upgrade removes io::Write on Sha256 and LowerHex on the output array. The bounded compatibility adaptation needs exact hash and I/O-error coverage while retaining every existing test, lane and zero-known-failure requirement.
verification: Guarded locked Cargo discovery must add exactly the four declared tests with no old-row change or removal. Bind the same zero-known-failure declaration to the new manifest. Fresh complete correctness/package/performance, clean release build and exact-head CI provide new-source evidence; the older declaration alone does not.
not_tested: Inventory discovery, package-byte parity and source checks do not establish general wave quality, installed runtime or physical-client acceptance. No input, ownership, desktop or delivery contract is changed.
